dphoneEmbedding.title: Embed dphone in other systems
dphoneEmbedding.description: Choose the websites (origins) allowed to embed this tenant's dphone. Up to {{limit}} entries.
dphoneEmbedding.readOnly: This account is read-only. Only tenant admins can make changes.

locked.title: Your current plan doesn't include dphone embedding
locked.body: Embedding dphone in other systems requires the CTI capability of the Enterprise plan. Contact sales to upgrade.

dphoneEmbedding.flagOff: dphone embedding isn't enabled for this tenant yet. You can add origins now, but embedding won't work until a platform operator enables it.

form.title: Add origin
form.originHint: Like https://crm.example.com — no path and no *
form.label: Display name
form.limitReached: You've reached {{limit}} origins. Delete or turn off unused ones first.

confirm.noSessions: No embedded dphone sessions from this origin are in use.

snippet.title: Code for the embedding system

teamScopes.title: Team VIEW permissions
teamScopes.description: Set screen-pop visibility by team and customer segment. VIEW does not allow calls or work actions.
teamScopes.readOnly: Only tenant administrators can manage VIEW permissions.

rejections.INVALID_URL: Not a valid URL. It must start with https://
rejections.USERINFO: The URL can't contain a username or password
rejections.PATH_QUERY_FRAGMENT: Use only scheme, host and port — no path, ? or #
rejections.IP_ADDRESS: IP addresses aren't allowed. Use a domain name

rejections.RESERVED_ORIGIN: This is a D-Contact origin and can't be added

screenPop.description: Choose which call data dphone sends to this host site. It is off by default.

screenPop.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters, recorded in the audit log
